method: The first 15 rows of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in file order. The file holds 242 rows and every one is cve-pairs-php (the Python and JavaScript rows were noted in earlier runs), so this batch is PHP only. For each case I read the fix commit (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and, where the diff did not show source or sink, the files at the fix commit's parent: df-core Package.php and Packager.php; MISP EventReport.php and EventReportsController.php; cyan-backup page-backups.php; importwp ImporterManager.php; Elementor class-import-images.php and template-library/manager.php; i-educar educar_matricula_lst.php; Part-DB AttachmentSubmitHandler.php (the added SVGSanitizer comes with the diff); cf7msm cf7msm.php; SemanticMediaWiki ProfileForm.php; groundhogg functions.php and file-box.php; Shaarli MetadataController.php and UrlUtils.php; easyappointments Booking_settings.php and booking_message.php; MantisBT admin/install.php; YesWiki CSVManager.php and BazarImportAction.php. No row was skipped. Two notes are unsure because the request side is outside the changed repository or file: df-core's password arrives through the API layer and Elementor's tmp_name caller is not visible in the import path. Six cases are stored-value flows (settings, cookies, importer config, an uploaded SVG) and one is a weak existing check (the Shaarli scheme substring test), so a rule needs those paths as well as direct request-to-sink flows.

notes.source: outside this repository (the DreamFactory API's package endpoint, which builds the manifest from the request body); src/Components/Package/Package.php:234 (fix parent): getPassword() returns array_get($this->manifest, 'password', $this->password), the password the caller set with setPassword() (:114) from the package creation POST
notes.sink: src/Components/Package/Package.php:666: @exec("cd $extractDir $commandSeparator zip -r -P $password $this->zipFile .", $output) - the password and the temp extract dir are interpolated into a shell string
notes.between: request body -> Package::setPassword()/constructor -> protected $password or manifest['password'] -> getPassword() -> saveZipFile(), which extracts the zip to a temp dir and calls exec(); there is no escapeshellarg() anywhere and the fix adds it (escaped dir/password/zip, native ZipArchive encryption first)
notes.fix: adds encryptZipWithNativeMethod() and an encryptZipWithShellCommand() that passes every argument through escapeshellarg()
notes.probe:
<?php
$password = $request->input('password');

class Package
{
    protected $password;

    public function setPassword($password)
    {
        $this->password = $password;
    }

    public function saveZipFile()
    {
        $password = $this->password;
        $dir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/pkg';
        exec("cd $dir ; zip -r -P $password out.zip .", $output);
    }
}

$p = new Package();
$p->setPassword($password);
$p->saveZipFile();

notes.source: app/Controller/EventReportsController.php:645 (fix parent): public function viewPicture($filename) - the filename is a CakePHP route parameter of /eventReports/viewPicture/<filename>
notes.sink: app/Model/EventReport.php:1615-1617: $filepath = self::PICTURE_FOLDER_PATH . '/' . $filename; $file = new File($filepath); then the controller returns it with $this->RestResponse->sendFile($image['file'], $extension)
notes.between: the controller passes the route argument straight to getPicture(), which first substitutes an alias from getImageFromAlias() and then concatenates the value with the picture directory; there is no basename() and no containment check, so ../ walks out of the picture folder and the file is sent back; the fix adds basename($filename) before the concatenation

notes.source: includes/page-backups.php:20-22 (fix parent): $postdata = $this->get_real_post_data(); then $file = $postdata['remove'][$index] (or $postdata['remove[' . $index . ']'] for a differently parsed body) - the raw POST body read through the plugin's request helper
notes.sink: includes/page-backups.php:24-31: if (($file = realpath($file)) !== FALSE) { @unlink($file); @unlink($logfile); } - any existing path on the server chosen by the form value
notes.between: the only processing is realpath(); nothing checks that the resolved path is one of the backup files listed on the page, so the admin form can delete any file the web server can unlink; the fix builds the backup list first and only unlinks a file whose realpath equals one entry
notes.fix: computes backup_files_info(get_backup_files()) and only unlinks the file (and its .log) when it is in that list

notes.source: class/Common/Importer/ImporterManager.php:663-666 (fix parent): $raw_source = $importer_data->getDatasourceSetting('local_url'); $source = apply_filters('iwp/importer/datasource/local', $source, $raw_source, $importer_data); $attachment_id = $this->local_file($importer_data, $source, ...) - the local_url saved in the importer's datasource settings
notes.sink: class/Common/Importer/ImporterManager.php:429-437: local_file() calls $this->filesystem->copy_file($source, $allowed_file_types, null, $prefix, $filetype), which opens and copies the path the setting names
notes.between: the datasource settings are saved by the importer's admin form and read back at import run time; the value goes through the two apply_filters hooks and then to copy_file() with no directory check, so a path outside wp-content is readable; the fix calls realpath($source) and requires it to start with realpath(WP_CONTENT_DIR) (or another allowed base from a filter)
notes.fix: adds an allowed-base check (realpath + strpos prefix) before copy_file()

notes.source: includes/template-library/classes/class-import-images.php:111 (fix parent): if (isset($attachment['tmp_name'])) { $filename = $attachment['name']; $file_content = Utils::file_get_contents($attachment['tmp_name']); } - the tmp_name key of the attachment array handed to import(); the direct upload entry point is includes/template-library/manager.php:641, which passes $_FILES['file']['tmp_name']
notes.sink: class-import-images.php:115: Utils::file_get_contents($attachment['tmp_name']) reads whatever path the array names, and the bytes are written into the uploads directory by wp_upload_bits($filename, null, $file_content)
notes.between: the attachment array (name, tmp_name, url, id) is passed to Import_Images::import(); for a file that was not uploaded through PHP the tmp_name is an arbitrary path, so a crafted import reads a local file into the media library; the fix only reads it when is_uploaded_file($attachment['tmp_name']) is true
notes.fix: gates the read behind is_uploaded_file($attachment['tmp_name']) and leaves $file_content false otherwise

notes.source: ieducar/intranet/educar_matricula_lst.php:62-64 (fix parent): foreach ($_GET as $var => $val) { $this->$var = ($val === '') ? null : $val; } - every query parameter becomes an object property under its own name
notes.sink: same file, :70 and :204: $this->campoOculto(nome: 'ref_cod_aluno', valor: $this->ref_cod_aluno) and $this->acao = "go(\"educar_matricula_cad.php?ref_cod_aluno={$this->ref_cod_aluno}\")" - the property is put into the hidden field and the generated link
notes.between: the loop sets properties the class declares (ref_cod_aluno, ref_cod_escola) from the query string through a dynamic property name; the page then renders them through the legacy campo/acao helpers; the fix replaces the loop with request()->integer('ref_cod_aluno') and request()->integer('ref_cod_escola'), so the value is cast and can no longer be a string
notes.fix: drops the $_GET-to-property loop and reads the two fields with request()->integer()

notes.source: src/Services/Attachments/AttachmentSubmitHandler.php:214 (fix parent): handleUpload(Attachment $attachment, ?AttachmentUpload $upload) receives the uploaded file; the file content is the attacker's SVG (the request is the attachment upload form)
notes.sink: the stored SVG is served from the attachments route and rendered by the browser; the fix's sink is SVGSanitizer::sanitizeFile() (new src/Services/Attachments/SVGSanitizer.php), which reads the saved file with file_get_contents() and writes the sanitized bytes back with file_put_contents()
notes.between: upload -> moveFile() into the secure attachment directory -> attachment saved with its internal path; when the extension is .svg the bytes are never inspected, so a <script> in the SVG runs when the file is opened from the app; the fix calls sanitizeSVGFiles() right after moveFile(), which hands internal SVGs to the DOMSanitizer
notes.fix: adds SVGSanitizer (rhukster/dom-sanitizer) and sanitizes internal .svg attachments in handleUpload()

notes.source: cf7msm.php:176-177 (fix parent): $cf7msm_posted_data = cf7msm_remove_honeypot_fields_from_posted_data( cf7msm_get( 'cf7msm_posted_data', [] ) ) - the form values saved on the previous step, kept in the cookie or session by cf7msm_set(), which serializes the submitted form data
notes.sink: cf7msm.php:181: wp_localize_script( 'cf7msm', 'cf7msm_posted_data', $cf7msm_posted_data ) - WordPress prints the array into the page as inline JavaScript, and an array key named l10n_print_after is emitted as executable code
notes.between: POST fields -> cf7msm_sanitize_posted_data() (utf8 check only) -> cookie/session -> cf7msm_get() on the next step -> wp_localize_script(); the reserved l10n_print_after key survives the storage and the sanitizer, so a form field named l10n_print_after (or a nested one) is run in the browser; the fix encodes the data with wp_json_encode(JSON_HEX_TAG|...) into an inline script and unsets the key in cf7msm_sanitize_posted_data()
notes.fix: replaces wp_localize_script() with an escaped wp_add_inline_script() and removes the l10n_print_after key before saving

notes.source: src/MediaWiki/Search/ProfileForm/ProfileForm.php:344 (fix parent): profile_sheet($query, $queryLink, $termPrefixes) builds the extended search profile from $query, which buildForm() takes from $this->specialSearch->getSearchEngine()->getQueryString() - the user's Special:Search term
notes.sink: ProfileForm.php:347: $text .= Html::rawElement( 'pre', [], $query ) . ' ' - the raw search text is put into the <pre> block of the profile sheet
notes.between: the search query travels from the request into the search engine and back as a string into profile_sheet(); every other element in the sheet is built with Html::element()/section(), only this one uses rawElement(), so a query containing <script> is reflected; the fix switches it to Html::element
notes.fix: uses Html::element( 'pre', [], $query ) so the query is escaped

notes.source: the REST endpoint POST /thirdparties/{id}/bankaccounts (outside this repository's changed file) sets $this->type from the request body, as the fix commit message names it; in the model the value is the public $type property
notes.between: the API controller builds a CompanyBankAccount from the JSON/form body and calls create(), which interpolates $this->type between SQL quotes - only socid is cast; the value crosses the controller and the object property, so a taint rule that stops at the method call misses it; the fix wraps the property in $this->db->escape()
notes.probe:
<?php
class BankAccount
{
    public $type;

    public function create($db)
    {
        $sql = "INSERT INTO bank (fk_soc, type) VALUES (" . ((int) $this->socid) . ", '" . $this->type . "')";

        return $db->query($sql);
    }
}

$account = new BankAccount();
$account->type = $request->input('type');
$account->create($db);

notes.source: includes/functions.php:2876-2884 (fix parent): in generate_contact_with_map(), case 'copy_file': if (is_string($value) && is_copyable_file($value)) { $copy[] = $value; } - $value is a mapped field of a CSV import row, a REST contact body or a webhook payload
notes.sink: includes/classes/traits/file-box.php:79-101: copy_file($url_or_path) passes file_exists($url_or_path) ? $url_or_path : download_url(...) as tmp_name to safe_file_sideload(), and on the error branch calls wp_delete_file($file['tmp_name']) - so an existing server path is either moved away or deleted
notes.between: the request row -> generate_contact_with_map() mapping -> copy_file(); the only gate is is_copyable_file(), which checks the hostname, so a local path like /var/www/html/wp-config.php passes; a path inside uploads is moved and a path outside is deleted by the cleanup; the fix accepts URLs only (is_copyable_url) and copies a local file to a temp file inside uploads before sideloading
notes.fix: adds is_copyable_url() (exact http/https scheme + same host) for the mapped value and copies allowed local files to a temp file instead of touching the original
notes.probe:
<?php
foreach ($map as $column => $target) {
    $value = $row[$column]; // one CSV row, REST body or webhook field

    if ($target === 'copy_file' && is_string($value) && file_exists($value)) {
        $file = ['name' => basename($value), 'tmp_name' => $value];
        $result = wp_handle_sideload($file, []);

        if (is_wp_error($result)) {
            wp_delete_file($file['tmp_name']);
        }
    }
}

notes.source: application/front/controller/admin/MetadataController.php:22 (fix parent): $url = $request->getParam('url') - the url query parameter of GET /admin/metadata
notes.sink: MetadataController.php:25-27: return $response->withJson($this->container->metadataRetriever->retrieve($url)) - the server fetches the URL and returns the page title/meta tags
notes.between: the only check was strpos(get_url_scheme($url) ?: '', 'http') !== false, a substring test that passes httpoxy and any destination, so loopback and private addresses are reachable; the fix replaces it with an exact in_array('http'/'https') and is_safe_url() (new in application/http/UrlUtils.php: resolves the host and rejects private/loopback/reserved IPv4), plus a CSRF token check
notes.fix: exact scheme match, a new is_safe_url()/is_private_ip() destination check and checkToken() on the admin endpoint

notes.source: tools/bazar/actions/BazarImportAction.php:105 (fix parent): the importentries action takes the posted import selection (the entries built from the uploaded CSV) and hands it to CSVManager::importEntry($importedEntries, $formId); each entry is a base64-encoded serialized string taken from the file's rows
notes.sink: tools/bazar/services/CSVManager.php:379: $entry = unserialize(base64_decode($entry)); then array_map('strval', $entry) - an object of any class in the autoloader is instantiated from the payload
notes.between: uploaded CSV -> the import form's entries -> POST to the importentries action -> CSVManager::importEntry() -> base64_decode() -> unserialize() with no allowed_classes limit, so a crafted cell runs the gadget chain; the fix passes ['allowed_classes' => false] and adds a CSRF token to the import form/action
notes.fix: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) plus a CSRF token on importentries
